scripts.prebuild: bash scripts/check-hardcoded-colors.sh || true && bun scripts/validate-dynamic-css.js && bun scripts/validate-js-conventions.js && bun scripts/copy-vendor.js && bun -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const distDir = path.join(__dirname, 'src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist'); try { fs.rmSync(distDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}"
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production bun x postcss ./src/main/resources/css/index.css -o ./src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist/main.css && NODE_ENV=production bun scripts/hash-css.js && NODE_ENV=production bun scripts/hash-js.js
scripts.build:dev: bun scripts/copy-vendor.js && bun scripts/validate-js-conventions.js && NODE_ENV=development bun x postcss ./src/main/resources/css/index.css -o ./src/main/resources/META-INF/resources/dist/main.css && NODE_ENV=development bun scripts/hash-css.js && NODE_ENV=development bun scripts/hash-js.js
scripts.preview: echo 'Preview not configured for CSS-only build'
